bio.text: Christian Hermanson, a Republican, represents District 59 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Hermanson as serving a first term and as a property manager.

The biography describes Hermanson as a former police officer and retired U.S. Air Force chief master sergeant who enlisted in the Army National Guard in 1995, transferred to the Air Force Reserve in 2000 and retired in 2024 after 29 years of service.
It lists associate degrees in criminal justice and strategic intelligence from the Community College of the Air Force, and says Hermanson was born near Scarville, Iowa, and lives in Mason City.
